title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 27 April 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 26 April 2026 Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in most parts of the island after 2.00 pm. Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm are likely at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and Central provinces and in Kurunegala, Galle and Matara districts. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Anuradhapura, Kurunegala and Badulla districts during the early hours of the morning The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
